value: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (2022). Oil and Natural Gas Sector: Emission Standards for New, Reconstructed, and Modified Sources and Emissions Guidelines for Existing Sources: Oil and Natural Gas Sector Climate Review. Supplemental Background Technical Support Document for the Proposed New Source Performance Standards (NSPS) and Emissions Guidelines (EG), 40 CFR Part 60 subpart OOOOb (NSPS) and subpart OOOOc (EG). October 2022 (for the December 6, 2022 supplemental proposal, 87 FR 74702). Research Triangle Park, NC: Office of Air Quality Planning and Standards. Docket ID No. EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-1578.

Targeted pass on the 173-page supplemental TSD; extracted only what the final TSD (epa_2023_002) does not supersede and says still applies: Ch.2 centrifugal compressors (wet seal to new combustor, to process, 3 scfm numerical limit for wet and dry seals, per compressor and segment), Ch.5 fugitive emissions at well sites (OGI at five frequencies for multi-wellhead and centralized-production model sites at the 0.5% leak generation rate EPA judged representative; quarterly OGI + AVO combinations; single-wellhead quarterly AVO) and Ch.7 control-device monitoring costs for 98% flares. Ch.3 controllers, Ch.4 pumps and Ch.6 associated gas are superseded by the final TSD and not extracted; Ch.8 industry capex comparison skipped; the 1.0% leak-rate tables, multipollutant tables, AVO-only tables for larger sites and regulatory-option tables are not extracted. Page numbers are printed chapter-page numbers. Costs 2019 USD (stated for Ch.2 and Ch.7; fugitive costs retained from the 2021 TSD, which is in 2019$). Tons are US short tons. Capacity = methane avoided per unit per year (target ch4). Wet-seal G&B numerical-limit annual cost 25,000 not repeated (already in epa_2023_001). Source defects: Table 5-2c bimonthly 1% methane reduction printed 5.46 (should be about 12.5); Tables 5-13, 5-14 and 5-16b have shifted rows (not used); Table 7-1 is titled Summary of IRF LEL Measurements but holds flare costs; Table 2-5 values printed as greater-or-equal; well-site annual costs do not say whether amortized capital is included.
